content: Anti-fraud beyond photo+GPS: liveness detection (blink/smile challenge-response, reduces fraud up to 91% vs deepdakes), passive checks (skin reflection, depth, thermal), mock-location flag detection, root/emulator/Magisk fingerprint detection, physics checks (impossible speed, GPS accuracy jitter patterns - real GPS noisy 5-30m fluctuating vs spoofed clean/constant), device fingerprint cross-check. Buddy punching (friend checking in for someone) is the main use case liveness solves.
